description: JST S2B-PH-SM4-TB(LF)(SN) — 2-pin PH-series wire-to-board connector, 2.00 mm pitch, side-entry SMD with tape-and-reel packaging. The de-facto single-cell LiPo battery connector for makers (matches Adafruit / SparkFun / Pimoroni / Pololu boards). Side-entry orientation places the mating cable parallel to the PCB surface — natural for board-edge battery leads.
name: jst-ph-2p
watch_out_for: POLARITY: the maker convention (Adafruit / SparkFun / Pololu) is red = + on pin 1, black = − on pin 2. JST itself does not define this — verify your battery's wire-to-pin assignment with a multimeter before first plug-in, or you can blow up the downstream regulator/charger. Side-entry (S2B) vs top-entry (B2B): this is the S2B side-entry SMD variant; B2B is the top-entry equivalent. Mating connector is PHR-2 housing with SPH-002T-P0.5S crimp pins.
